items.description:
Lead-footed fighting cock — The special features of this special type of chicken

According to stories from the old days or the experience of long-time cockers, the lead-legged chicken is considered a rare breed of chicken that is favored by nature for the numbered legs of the “gods, lingos”. “. So the truth of this lead-legged chicken is true to the rumors. Let’s find out with DaGa321 now.

Some brothers with long experience said: Green-footed, yellow-legged fighting cocks, especially lead legs (also known as Nhat Nguyet and millet) are chickens that have a very good fighting style.

However, just looking at the legs to decide whether the cockfights or fights directly is not enough. You need to look at the potential inside of the chicken, which is shown through its body shape and gait.

Chicken with lead legs
Characteristics of lead-legged chicken — Daga321
To be properly recognized as a sun and moon fighting cock, they must possess the following body type: short legs, stooping generals, wings folded backward, large feathers wet with tail feathers along with long pins on the ground…

Normally, this fighting cock general is difficult for anyone to accept. However, if they own the legs of the sun and moon, then it is true that the chickens have 1, not 2. So the brothers can identify the lead-legged chicken breed and then decide accordingly to “buy” them or not. is not.

Choose lead-legged chicken according to feng shui
For normal fighting cocks, not many people like roosters with big dragon combs because they are only used as props for the opponent to beat. However, once this dragon’s comb is combined with the three-legged legs of the lead-legged chicken, the small and long toes, the fighting cock can become a “mighty” fighting cock with fighting power as well as killing power. The damage inflicts on an opponent is extremely respectable.

Discover the unique features of lead-legged chicken
Many cockers who have many years of experience and have raised fighting cocks affirm that any opponent can beat no matter how good the body, big size, no matter what type of chicken. This lead leg will often fight on the vertical side, when dealing with at least 3–5 attacks, they will let go of their beaks, never run away as soon as they enter the pool.

As for the face-shaking chicken with round face powder, the cockroach brothers often call it a moon-faced fighting cock. This type of chicken is very good. If combined with the fighting style of lead-legged chickens, it will have a style of “hit fast and win fast”.

Some fighting positions of lead-legged chickens “invincible victory”

Some fighting positions of lead-legged chickens “invincible victory”
Cage avoidance: this style of fighting cock always kicks the opponent, always pushes the opponent to the bottom, when locked in a cage, the chicken’s gait is like being drunk. The fighting cock is especially famous for its horizontal talent, turning on both sides with extremely flexible vision, so it is not a problem for the cock to fight with 2 opponents. This fighting position of the fighting cock seems to have no opponent, but it is still a bit wary of the cocks that fight and fight vertically. When you meet opponents with a style above you, you need to be very attentive.
Five-color chicken is the type in which the cockroach brothers will choose chickens according to the color of their feathers, only found in vermilion chickens. The five colors in the business world are said to be purebred chickens, so they fight very well, they have the ability to turn and change with very beautiful kicks, especially horizontal swings.
Elephant feather fighting cock: very rare, but if you can meet this type of chicken, you can always buy one because in history this chicken is ranked first in the best fighting chickens, it is difficult to find any kind of chicken. can be the enemy.
In addition, on the market today, it is quite rare to find lead-legged chicken breeds, so the price of this type of chicken is quite high compared to other fighting cock breeds.

And that’s also what I want to share with you about lead-legged chicken. Hopefully, the information that Daga321 provides can help you get more interesting and useful information. Thank you very much for your attention to the article.

Source : https://daga321.com/ga-choi-chan-chi-nhung-net-dac-sac-cua-loai-ga-dac-biet-nay/
